resources.string: Uses already-paired Bluetooth Classic devices. Pair devices in Android Bluetooth settings first. RELYRA verifies the contact identity with an Ed25519 challenge before sending encrypted messages. BLE discovery is not included.
This device has no Bluetooth adapter.
Turn on Bluetooth in Android settings.
Waiting for a trusted paired RELYRA contact.
At least one trusted Bluetooth peer was authenticated.

Discovers nearby Wi-Fi Direct devices without a router. Choose a device to form a peer-to-peer group. Discovery names and addresses are not trusted identities; RELYRA authenticates contacts with Ed25519 before data exchange. Android may require Location mode on older versions.
Wi-Fi Direct is not supported on this device.
Wi-Fi Direct is unavailable or switched off.
Searching for nearby Wi-Fi Direct devices.
Wi-Fi Direct group formed. Only authenticated contacts can exchange messages.

Creates a direct data channel using ICE/STUN and optional operator-provided TURN. Signed offers and answers are exchanged automatically inside RELYRA end-to-end encrypted messages over your enabled Nostr relay when available. Incoming offers always require your approval. Manual copy/paste remains available when no relay route exists. SDP can reveal network addresses; WebRTC data does not use the Tor SOCKS proxy.
Paste the received offer or answer
Signed signaling data — copy and send only to the intended peer
Optional TURN settings for networks that block direct connectivity
Invalid TURN details. Enter a TURN URI, username and credential.
Could not create or verify signaling. Check the contact identity, signal expiry and network settings.
Answer accepted; ICE connectivity checks are running.
Signed connection signal sent through an available RELYRA route.
No enabled route accepted the signal. Copy the signed signaling data and exchange it privately with the contact.
A verified contact is requesting a direct WebRTC connection. Approve only if you expected this request.

Add an HTTPS RELYRA discovery gateway backed by the distributed Kademlia network. Public presence is off by default. When enabled, your RELYRA public ID and supported connection capabilities are published as a signed, three-minute lease; no name, SDP or IP address is published.
